# Autoikigai

## About
Autoikigai is a done-for-you B2B lead generation agency. We build and run outbound systems (cold email and LinkedIn) that put qualified sales meetings on our clients' calendars. Clients do not hire SDRs, buy tools, or learn deliverability — we handle all of it.

## What We Do
We run the full outbound process:
- Target list building and enrichment
- Sending domain setup with SPF/DKIM/DMARC
- Inbox warmup (your main domain is never at risk)
- Cold email and LinkedIn sequence writing
- A/B testing and optimization
- Reply management within hours
- Lead qualification
- Calendar booking with qualified prospects

## Who We Work With
Founders of B2B companies with 5-50 employees who sell a service or software worth at least $5,000 per customer per year:
- B2B SaaS companies
- Agencies
- Consultancies
- IT services firms

They close deals well once on a call. Their problem is not enough calls.

## How It Works
1. Pipeline Audit: We review your current offer, buyers, and sales process
2. ICP & Offer: We build your target list and sharpen your offer
3. Infrastructure: Separate sending domains, proper DNS authentication, warmup
4. Messaging: We write the sequences and A/B test them
5. Launch & Booking: Replies handled within hours, qualified prospects booked onto your calendar

## Timeline
- First emails out in 14 days
- Most clients see first qualified meetings within 3-4 weeks

## Pricing
Custom pricing based on your goals, determined after a discovery call. Pay-per-meeting model available. Monthly retainer options available after pilot.

Qualified meeting = A decision-maker at a company matching your agreed ICP who shows up to the call.
